title: Matsya: Cyclone Arnab: radar updates
description: This is not an official warning. For alerts, follow IMD, APSDMA and your district officers.

items.title: More land is probably flooded than on the last radar pass.
items.content_text: The satellite looked again on 9 Nov, 12 days after landfall. Radar points to about 84 square km of new open water (61 to 108 with other settings). That is more than ten times a normal fortnight.
items.summary: More land is probably flooded than on the last radar pass.

items.title: No mandal looks probably flooded in this radar picture.
items.content_text: NISAR looked at the coast on 28 Oct, the day Cyclone Arnab reached land. Radar shows only small patches of likely new open water, too few to call any mandal flooded. Radar points to about 8 square km of new open water (5 to 13 with other settings). That is about 4 times a normal fortnight.
items.summary: No mandal looks probably flooded in this radar picture.
